notes.title: How to Play Fruitimo!
notes.content:
Let’s introduce how to play Fruitimo! 🎉

＜The 3 Basic Rules＞
1️⃣ Throw jelly!
2️⃣ Vacuum up the fruits you find!
3️⃣ Carry the fruits to the goal!

When you reach the goal, the results will be shown.
Play again and again to beat your own record!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/2420d0212e21708348cff8eb4583386d736d6631.jpg"]


How will you play today?
Fruitimo! is a game where you collect fruits and reach the goal…
but that’s not the only way to have fun!
You can play in all sorts of styles depending on your mood.

For example…


🍓 Collect only your favorite fruit
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/87b643b42f036842ca3918fa308e923b184d52f7.jpg"]

🍎 Collect every single fruit
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/4bec7bb071ac035d7fd8815ced3c319aaf8a9d6e.jpg"]

🎈 Skip collecting and just explore Kajune Land in your own style
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45681252/f9580077634f49c73d6659d02625fc7185e93497.jpg"]



How will you play today?

If you find a fun way to play, let us know!
